# Simon Willison’s Weblog

Releasedatasette-mcp 0.4— Adds a /-/mcp MCP server to any Datasette instance

Fixed for compatibility with Datasette 1.0a44.

Posted 27th November 2026 at 12:26 am

Three LLM inflection points in twelve months - 24th November 2026 Ladybird's first alpha release - 23rd November 2026 Running the full server-side Datasette Python app in the browser with service workers and Pyodide - 17th November 2026 Locating the source of a mysterious beep with Claude - 9th November 2026

This is a **beat** by Simon Willison, posted on 27th November 2026.
